botUpdate.policy: public-set response search for Very Strong RandBats
botUpdate.browserAdapter: static sprites, move animations on, silent
botUpdate.championsArena: Every Champions level (Medium, Strong, Very Strong) runs the stable Discharge search (native-reply-control); lower levels sample more widely among near-best moves and leads
botUpdate.ratedPlay: Games are rated by default (per-format rating in the browser picks Medium, Strong or Very Strong); the game-type picker offers unrated levels
botUpdate.variety: Champions bot goes through its whole team pool in a shuffled order before repeating, remixes sets only with moves, items and abilities that published teams gave the same species, and samples wider among near-best moves
botUpdate.switching: Very Strong pays a small search cost for switching, larger for consecutive switches and for cycling a Pokemon back in or out
botUpdate.randomBattle: Very Strong Random Battles use a port of Foul Play (GPL-3.0) searching with poke-engine (MIT) compiled to WebAssembly; the previous bot is the fallback
botUpdate.gameReview: Finished Champions games are saved in the browser (last 8); review.html replays one in the Champions worker and shows, per decision, what Discharge would have played in the player seat, its win-chance estimate and the replies it expected
botUpdate.damageGame: damage.html asks the Champions worker (calc message) for a position built from two pool teams and all 16 Showdown damage rolls of one move, for a guessing game

championsWorker.builtFrom: bot commit b9aca69 plus the game-review, damage-game and level changes in bot-updates/review-v3.zip, scripts/build-champions-browser.mjs, Showdown a5df8274e85b0889bf2a9b3422a08b39732374fc
